verdict.rationale: Mintlify ships a CLI (`mint`) with headless-friendly commands like `mint validate`, `mint broken-links`, and `mint export` confirmed by live probe, plus a REST API for triggering deployments and automations that run on schedule/repo push/integration events — all usable in CI without a UI. missing for 10: no first-party CI/CD template or GitHub Actions example demonstrating a full pipeline invocation, and no independent (non-vendor) confirmation of CI usage in practice.
